//: Separate from tsconfig.json because the Next config is noEmit and bundler-resolved. The MCP server is a standalone Node process, so it needs a real emit and Node's own module resolution. node16 is used (not 'node') so the MCP SDK's package exports map resolves; CJS output keeps extension-less relative imports working, matching the rest of src/.
//lib: DOM is included for its fetch typings only. src/lib/etherscan.ts is shared with the Next app, where the DOM lib supplies RequestInit.cache ('no-store', which is meaningful to Next's fetch cache) and types Response.json() as any. Dropping DOM here would mean either weakening those types or changing etherscan.ts in a way that alters Next's caching behavior.
